children: Keep several Cascades and group them in folders. The one you have open saves itself as you work.
How eagerly the tree grows on its own.
Standard has a top bar, a block dock and an action strip. Minimal is only the canvas: tap empty space for a menu, or tap a block for its actions. Applies when the screen is narrow.
Grow branches after I place a block
Off means blocks are only placed. The sparkle button on any node grows it on demand.
Bridge or trace back when I drop an emotion block
Works from the existing tree toward the feeling and back from the feeling to its causes, and starts a grill if the two cannot meet. With little in the tree yet, it only traces back.
Roughly 6, 9 or 13 suggested nodes each time.
Push back on my answers in a grill
The AI challenges weak or risky answers instead of nodding along. It never writes an answer for you.
A round shows every question that is ready at once. One at a time shows a single card.
Lower is more predictable, higher is more varied. Placement always runs cool so it stays consistent. Some newer models ignore this.
The theme, and the look of your blocks and wires. Changes show on the canvas as you make them.
Point Cascade at a project folder and it learns from it.

Reading and searching happen on this computer. When you build a brief, short digests and code excerpts go to the AI you connected, never your keys, and anything that looks like a secret is skipped or redacted first.
One pattern per line, written like a .gitignore. The project’s own .gitignore and each engine’s generated folders are skipped already.
Comma separated. Binary files are never read.

children: This is exactly what the AI is told about your project. Fix anything that’s wrong. Your goal and pillars always take precedence.
Use the brief in every AI call
Let Ask and Grill look things up in the project’s files and cite them
Seed the graph from the project
Seeding drafts suggested nodes (decisions already made, open questions, fog) as ghosts you keep or dismiss. Each one remembers the file it came from.
Your tree and settings live in the folder next to
Your tree and settings are saved in this browser. Export the tree to keep a copy or move it somewhere else.
Count how this site is used

Counts only, such as visits, blocks placed or kept, and which AI provider was used. No tree text, prompts, keys or names, and no cookies. Do Not Track turns it off automatically. The local app sends nothing.
Stop Cascade when I close this tab
Off by default. When on, closing the last Cascade tab shuts the server down a few seconds later, so the port is freed without opening a terminal.
Remove all saved keys and sign-ins
Clearing the graph can be undone. Forgetting keys can’t.
